Vandana karthe hai ham! (2)
Hriday ko tere samne
Laakar rakhthe hai ham!

Hirday mein mere
Masiha Jeevan deep jalaa
Hriday ke papo ko dhokar
Prem ki rah dikha! (2)

Mei hoon nirbal manav
Paapo ke sagar mein khoya
Ab thum sambhalo
Yeeshuji
Bhav sagar mei hoon khoya! (2)

Shakti dhe dho mujhko
Mera nahi koi meet
Jeevan ko mere le lo
Gaaoon main tere hi geet! (2)

songs.title: Aaj ka dhin

lines: Ham is mein aanandit ho, aanandit ho! (2)
Wo bade mai ghatu, rahe isi ka dhyaan! (2)
Mujh ko hai tujh se aas
Mujh ko kabul kar le - mere

songs.text:
Aaj ka dhin
Yehovah ne banaya hai
Ham is mein aanandit ho, aanandit ho! (2)

Prabhu ko mahima mile,
Chaahe ho mera apmaan
Wo bade mai ghatu, rahe isi ka dhyaan! (2)

Aatha hoon tere paas
Mujh ko hai tujh se aas
Mujh ko kabul kar le - mere
Paapo se shudh kar dhe!

Sthuthi Prashansa kare,
Kyo na kuch hota rahe
Usko ham baathe rahe,
Chaahe jahaan bhi rahe! (2)

songs.title: Yeeshu bulaatha thumhe (2)

lines: Badi chaahat se thumko baahon mein lene,
Shanthi voh dhega thumhe Yeeshu theri mukti aur roshni hai
Bina kisi bhed ke thaiyaar uddharak
Apni dhaya se pyaar karne ko!

songs.text:
Yeeshu bulaatha thumhe (2)
Badi chaahat se thumko baahon mein lene,
Yeeshu bulaatha thumhe! (2)

Dukh ki gaharaiyon mein
Dhega voh shanti thumhe
Soch samajh kar usse nihaaro
Anand anokha dhega thumhe!

Aansu mitaakar tere
Raksha karega theri
Apni aankho ki puthli jaise
O Sachchi suraksha dhega tumhe!

Agar tera dhil dukhit ho,
Shanthi voh dhega thumhe Yeeshu theri mukti aur roshni hai
Sankoch mitakar aao abhi!

Har rog mitaane ki
Shakti hai uske paas
Bina kisi bhed ke thaiyaar uddharak
Apni dhaya se pyaar karne ko!

songs.title: Chale jaane hai

lines: Lekar Yeeshu ka pyara pyara naam! (2)
Jis naam se ham ko anandh mile
Us anandh se ham badthe chale (2)
Voh hi naam - pyaara pyaara naam!
Jis naam se ham ko mukthi/shanthi mile
Us shanthi se ham badthe chale (2)
Voh hi naam - pyaara pyaara naam!
Jis naam se andhe dekhne lage
Voh hi naam - pyaara pyaara naam!

songs.text:
Chale jaane hai
Dhoor se dhoor chal kar!
Lekar Yeeshu ka pyara pyara naam! (2)

Jis naam se ham ko anandh mile
Us anandh se ham badthe chale (2)
Voh hi naam - pyaara pyaara naam!

Jis naam se ham ko mukthi/shanthi mile
Us shanthi se ham badthe chale (2)
Voh hi naam - pyaara pyaara naam!

Jis naam se andhe dekhne lage
Naam se langde chalne lage
Voh hi naam - pyaara pyaara naam!

songs.title: Parmeshwar ke ghar

lines: Wahaan Khushi hai, khushi hai khushi hai!

songs.text:
Parmeshwar ke ghar
Parmeshwar ke ghar
Ham chale
Parmeshwar ke ghar (2)
Wahaan Khushi hai, khushi hai khushi hai!

(Kannada)

Baniri hogona namma
Thande manege
Namma Thande manege,
Namma Thande manege
Banniri hogona namma
Thande manege
Alli yendendhu santhosha ve irvodhu!

songs.title: Naare lagao aur gao re
songs.text:
Naare lagao aur gao re,
Jhanda maseeh ka phailao re! (2)
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah Hallelujah
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah Hallelujah!

songs.title: Maango tho thumko mil jaayega
songs.text:
Maango tho thumko mil jaayega
Dhuundo tho thum usse paaoge
Khat khatao thum darwaze ko
Voh thumhaare liye khul jaayega!

songs.title: Kisne banaaya phoolonko

lines: You are my friend in need
I will worship you, with all of my heart!
I will seek your face, all through my life@
I will serve you Lord, with all that

songs.text:
Kisne banaaya phoolonko
Phoolongko, phoolonko?
Kisne banaaya phoolonko
Ishwar jo swarg mei hai! (2)
Kisne banaaya thaaro ko…?
Kisne banaaya machili ko…?
Kisne banaaya thumko humko…?
You are my refuge,
You are my fortress
You are my friend in need
You are my God!

I will worship you, with all of my heart!
I will seek your face, all through my life@
I will serve you Lord, with all that
I am!
Here I am!
Here I am, Oh Lord (3)
Here I am!

songs.title: Thu mera sharan sthaan

lines: Aaradhna karu main poore dhil se
Srishti ke har ek kan kan me
Chaaya hai theri hi mahima ka raaj (2)
Pakshi bhi karthe hai teri prashansa (2)
Har pal sunathe hai anand ka raag!
Meri bhi bhakti tujhe grehan ho
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe
Teri seva karunga meri saare chezon se
Thu meraa geet hai, mera sangeeth hai
Patit jeevan mein jyothi jala dhe
Tujh hi se lagi hai aasha meri (2)
Paap mein than ko dhoor hataa dhe (2)
Jeevan ke kathin dhukhi shano ka
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe

songs.text:
Thu mera sharan sthaan
Dhaya ki yaachana karu!

Teri aradhana

Thu mera gadaa hai
Sankat mein mera dhosth,
Mera Prabhu! (2)

Aaradhna karu main poore dhil se
Mei Thuje doondoonga
Sampoorna jeevan mein

Srishti ke har ek kan kan me
Chaaya hai theri hi mahima ka raaj (2)
Pakshi bhi karthe hai teri prashansa (2)
Har pal sunathe hai anand ka raag!
Meri bhi bhakti tujhe grehan ho
Hriday se praarthana karu
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe

Teri seva karunga meri saare chezon se
Mei hoon yahaa!

Dhaya ki yaachana karu!

Teri aradhana
Mei hoon yahaa,
Prabhu (3)
Main hoon yahaan!

Thu meraa geet hai, mera sangeeth hai
Thu meri aasha,
Mera Prabhu!
- Aaradhana

Patit jeevan mein jyothi jala dhe
Tujh hi se lagi hai aasha meri (2)
Paap mein than ko dhoor hataa dhe (2)
Poorna ho abhilasha meri
Jeevan ke kathin dhukhi shano ka
Dhridtha se samna karu
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe

Is liye gaayenge,
Sabko bathayenge

Dhaya ki yaachana karu

songs.title: Theri aradhana karoon

lines: Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe
Shaktimaan Thu hi hai mere jeevan ka sangeeth (2)
Jeevan se mere thu mahima paaye
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe

songs.text:
Theri aradhana karoon
Theri aradhana karoon
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe
Dhaya ki yaachana karoon
Theri aradhana karoon!

Thu hi mahaan sarva
Shaktimaan Thu hi hai mere jeevan ka sangeeth (2)
Hriday ke thaar chede jhankaar (2)
Teri aradhana hai madhur geeth!
Jeevan se mere thu mahima paaye
Ek hi kamna karu
Paap kshama kar jeevan dhe dhe

songs.title: Teri aradhana
songs.text:
Teri aradhana
Yesu Raja
Ekhi Masih hai (2)
Alleluyah Amen
Alleluya Alleluya Amen
Alleluya (2)

Yesu Raja
Ekhi Masih hai
Yesu Raja
Ekhi Masih hai

Yesu Raja
Shanthi dhiyaa hai (2)

Yesu Raja
Shakthi dhiyaa hai (2)

songs.title: Abrahamana Dhevare, ninage aradhane
songs.text:
Abrahamana Dhevare, ninage aradhane
Eesaakana Dhevare ninage aradhane
Yakobina Dhevare ninage aaradhane
Thandhe maganige pavithrathmarige
Naa maaduve aradhane
Aaradhane, aaradhane!

Naanu sukhavagi balabekendhu
Nannannu srushti madidhe
Naanu ninna sthuthisabekendu
Hesarididu ni karede
Krupa purnane, O krupa purnane
Usiriruva dhinavella naa maduve aaradhane!

Hrudayadha thumba ninna jnapaka
Adhannu bittare berenillappa
Lokavella huduki na bandhe
Ellu sigalilla ninnantha thande
Karunamayane, O karunamayane
Badhukiruva dhinavella
Naa maduve aradhane naanu!

songs.title: Nanna hathiraviru, O Yesuve -
songs.text:
Nanna hathiraviru, O Yesuve -
Naa
Ninnanu bittu baalalaarenu (2)
Halleluya! (4)

Kathaleya samayadhi belakaagiru
Maranadha samayadhi jeevavagiru (2)

Kannirina samayadhi thaayiyaagiru
Saaladha samayadhi thandheyagiru (2)

Ninna vaakya odhuva samayadhi
Guruvaagiru
Praarthisuva samayadhi
Dhevaraagiru (2)

songs.title: Endhu ananda nannesu neeḍuva
songs.text:
Endhu ananda nannesu neeḍuva
Sthuthisuve sthutisuve sthutisutthale iruve
Halleluya Aanandave! (2)

Unnathana mareyali
Shaktana neraḷalli endhu iruvenu
Karthana nodi aashraya bande
Endhe karevenu! (2)
- Halleluya

Rekkeyinda nanna hodhisi
Kaadhu nadesuva
Aathana vachana aathmana aayudha
Nanage kedayavu (2)
- Halleluya

Margadhalella nannanu kaayalu
Dhootharu nanaguntu
Kaalu kallige thagaladha haage
Karadhalli hidivaru (2)
- Halleluya

Simhadha melu sarpadha melu
Nadedhe hoguve
Vairiya sakala shakthiya jayisalu
Adhikara nanaguntu! (2)
- Halleluya

Kastadha samayadhi kareyuva nanage
Utthara needuva
Nannodaniddhu bidugade kottu
Nannannu nadesuva! (2)
- Halleluya

songs.title: Sthothravanuthama
songs.text:
Sthothravanuthama
Dhevarigarbisa banni
Urdhvadhi karthage
Mahimeyaagali anni
Harushadhi dhoothara sangadhalli
Sthothra suganthavaathanni!

Budhivaa lokagalaathana
Swakiyaa Raajya
Yaavanu bhudhiava rajana
Sangada vyaajya
Maaduvanu Aaathanu nudiyalu
Marthyara gaddhala thyajya!

Kristhanu Krayake konda
Raajyavidhdheve;
Rajana chiththakke oppali
Dhasara Seve
Odayanu Namage oleyalu
Sukadhi jeevisutheve!

songs.title: Santhaisuva thaayiyanthe
songs.text:
Santhaisuva thaayiyanthe
Nannesu nannanu!

Halleluya…Halleluya (2)

Oragisuva edheyalli
Mana bhaarava neeguva! (2)

Karahididhu nadesuva
Kanmaniyanthe kaayuva! (2)

Jeeva kottanu nanagaagi
Nanna paapava hotthanu! (2)

Nannanendu kaibidanu
Endigu nanna agalanu! (2)

songs.title: Yesuve naavu ninna alaya

lines: Ukkisu nammalli jeeva jala Jala, jala, jala, jala, jeeva jala

songs.text:
Yesuve naavu ninna alaya
Ukkisu nammalli jeeva jala Jala, jala, jala, jala, jeeva jala
Idhu Dhevara athmana bala!

Odi naavu dhaniyadhanthe
Nadedhu naavu balaladhanthe
Dhayapalisu ninna aathmana bala
- Jala

Dhuraathma senegala mele
Naavu horadi jayahondhalu
Dhayapaalisu ninna aathmana bala

Jala

Andhakaara shaktigala mele
Naavu horadi jayahondhalu
Dhayapaalisu ninna aathmana bala
- Jala

songs.title: Appa appa

lines: Yesu naanu nimmalli Nimma vaakya nannalli

songs.text:
Appa appa
Yesappa
Neene nanna sarvasva (2)
Naanu ninnannu bittu
Yenu madalarenu! (2)
1 .Nanna nadeyindhaagali
Nanna nudiyindhaagali
Ninna naamavondhe mahime hondhali! (2)
Nanna sarvaaangagalu
Ninna sthuthi maadali (2)

Sarva srrushtige neenu yejamaananu
Sarva lokavu ninage adda bilali (2)
Sarva janaru ninnalli bandhu serali! (2)

Yesu naanu nimmalli Nimma vaakya nannalli
Nimma praarthaneyalli
Nanage jaya sigali (2)
Naanu nimmalli iddhu
Bahaḷa falava koḍuvenu! (2)

songs.title: Dhevara rajyakkaagi

lines: Aa hotthina kaata aa hotthige saaku!

songs.text:
Dhevara rajyakkaagi
Neethigaagi thavakapaḍi
Aga ella dhorakuvudhu
Ella, ella nimagella dhorakuvudhu!

Bhulokadhalli gantu madi
Ittuko byadha avu tukkididu,
Nusi hididhu naashavaagi hoguvudhu!

Naalina vishayadhalli nishchinteyaagiru
Aa hotthina kaata aa hotthige saaku!

Paralokadha gantu shashvatavaagiruvudu
Alli kallaru illa kadhimaru illa!

songs.title: Ninna preethisalu
songs.text:
Ninna preethisalu
Ee hrudhaya saaladhu
Yesayya
Innu hechaagi preethisuva aase nanagayya
Sthothra Yesayya (2)
Mahime Yesayya! (2)

Rogagalannu vaasi maadi
Hosa jeevana nanage tandhe
Nannannu nashanadindha
Thappisidhavaru neeve
Samr̥uddhi jeevana nanage neediruve (2)
Ninna preethiyannu varṇisalu
Ee hrudaya thavaka padutthidhe
Yesayya Sthothra
Yesayya (2)
Mahime Yesayya! (2)

Yesuve ninna rakthadhindha
Nannannu shuddhi madidhe
Parishudda aathmanindha
Nannannu thumbisiruve
Nammaya paapagala kshamisiruve
Ninna preethiyannu varṇisalu
Ee hrudaya tavaka padutthidhe
Yesayya Sthothra
Yesayya (2)
Mahime Yesayya! (2)

Shasvata premadinda nannannu preethisiruve
Nannannu mamateyinda seledhukonde Yesuve
Ninna prithiyannu varnisalu
Ee hrudhaya tavaka padutthidhe
Yesayya Sthothra
Yesayya (2)
Mahime Yesayya! (2)

songs.title: Aathma swarupane
songs.text:
Aathma swarupane
Priya Aathma swarupane
Igaa belagi aasirvadhisu
Namma madhyadolu (2)

Holasadha kesarinindha
Nannannu rakshisidi
Paapa tholedhu shuddhi padisu
Ee divya samayadolu!

Sinaai bettadhalli
Ilidhu bandhavane
Aathma dhaahava theerisayya
Ee dhivya samayadolu!

Aathmana varagalindhaa
Nannannu thumbisayya
Eddhu minugalu
Abisheka maadayya
Ee dhivya samayadholu!

songs.title: Ninnantha Dhevaru yaaru illa
songs.text:
Ninnantha Dhevaru yaaru illa
Ninna haage preethisuvavaru obbaru illa
Yesayya Yesayya ninilladhe naanilayya!

Papadha maranadhalli iddhantha nanna
Preethi maadi praana kottu
Badhukisidhe Dheva
Ninna krupe shashvata endhendhu
Dheva Ninna prieethiyindha naanu
Jeevisuve Dheva!

Nannaya jeevithavellavannu
Thilidhiruve neenu
Nannaya kurithu hithavagi chintisuve neenu
Ninnaya karadhi hididu
Nanna nadesiruve
Dheva
Nanna sahaya nanna bande neene
Yesayya!

Kashtagalalli dhukhagalalli
Jotheyagiruvavanu Rogadhalli saṅkatagalalli
Balava koduvavanu
Korathegalannu neegisuvavanu
Neene Yesayya
Solugalalli jayavannu koduva
Dheva neenayya!

songs.title: Yagnadha kurimariye nannesu
songs.text:
Yagnadha kurimariye nannesu
Rajane
Nannannu badhukisalu ninnondhu baliyadeya

Aradhane, Aradhane (2)
Halleluya, Halleluya (2)

Mul kiritava dharisikonde
Chatiya hodetha hodesikonde (2)
Apahaasyava sahisikonde
Mukhakke ugisikonde! (2)

Kai kaalgaḷalli moḷe hoḍhidharu
Bharjiya thivitha pakkeyalli
Aa rakthavu suriyithu dhareyalli (2)
Nammellara paapavu theerisithu! (2)

songs.title: Yaavaagalu karthanalli santhoshisiri
songs.text:
Yaavaagalu karthanalli santhoshisiri
Santhosha padiri
Yendhu thirigi heluthene (2)

Yaar yaaru aathanannu angikarisidharo
Aathana hesarinalli nambikeittaru
Avarige sikkuvadhu
Nijavaadha santoshavu (2)

Yaar yaaru prabhuvina sammukadhalliye
Hechinna samayavannu kalleyuthiruvaro
Avarige sikkuvadhu
Paralokha santoshavu! (2)

Yaar yaaru prabhuvina vakygalanella
Prithisi kaikondu nadeyuthiruvaro
Avarige sikkuvadhu
Mahime santhoshavu! (2)

songs.title: Jenina ruchigintha
songs.text:
Jenina ruchigintha
Yesu su
Naamavu
Dhivya madhuravaadhe - adhanu
Dhyanake thandhu hondhalu
Bannirathana sevakare!

Lokadha mele preethiya thumbi
Kashtagalanu thali paapa
Shokava harisi shaapava kaledhanu
Dhyanisu nee manave!

Paapiyanulisalu higeye thanna
Praanavanne kotta shreshta
Boopana karune sustithavadhannu
Bidadhe sevisiri!

Maatha apitharam
Bandhu balagavam
Aathukondarenu neenu
Neethiya christhanna
Preethiya harshadim
Sambramisu manave!

Boolokadhavaru melokadhavaru
Kirthipa naamava - bajisi
Melina dhanavam hondhuvirellaru
Nishchaya nishchayave!

songs.title: Naa sthuthisuvenu
songs.text:
Naa sthuthisuvenu
Naanu bajisuvenu
Karthana naamakke mahimeyanu
Sallisi endhu namisuvenu
Sthothrakke aatthane yogyanu! (2)

Aathana krupe preethi karunegala
Varnisal endhigu asaadhyavu
Paapiya dhennanu rakshisalendhu
Thoridha premavu apaaravu!

Karthana nambidha dhinandhindhalu
Maadidha upakaaragal ellavannu
Yochisal lennaya hrudhayavella
Kruthagnatheindha thumbuvadhu!

songs.title: Dharaniya janare paadiri koodi
songs.text:
Dharaniya janare paadiri koodi
Parasuthanaamavanu - aatha
Paravannu bittu lokakke
Bandu naranaagudisidnu!

Aadamaninda lokakke praapathavaada
Shrameyu poga - lathi
Modhava thaalutha rakshane maadalu
Ee dhina kaanisida!

Bhoparalokagalaikyava maadi
Shaapa harisuvanthe - eega
Paapadha rupavanaathanu etthutha
Kopakke guriyaadha!

Baanavaridhina kaanisikondu
Maanavarige saari - para
Gnaanadi geethava habbuthalaathanu
Maanava thilisidaru!

Paradholu mahime bhuviyolu
Divyakaruneya saaridharu - andu
Nararolu harshva huttisi
Avaru paralokakkeeridaru!

Neethiya suryanu ee dhina hutti
Prithiyemage saari - nama
Gaathanu thanna rekkeya kelage
Bhithiya nigidhanu!

Nuthanavaagiye huttidha raajanu
Saithaanana jayisi - thanna
Maathannu lokadholellaru
Keluvollaathanu maaduvanu!

Banniri eega aathanigeragi
Thanniri ghanamaana - avanannu
Vishesha prithiya maadutha
Banniri sevisuvaa!

songs.title: Koodi dhootharindu dharanigodi
songs.text:
Koodi dhootharindu dharanigodi
Seridharu parana
Haadi paadidharu guruva
Noda saaridharu
Kudindu banniri haadannu thanniri!

Pithana neemakada dhinadha
Suthanu thappisade ilidhu
Bethleheminolu endhu hithanu huttidhanu
Pithaneekaputhranu
Athisundaraanganu!
- Ahha koodi

Paramalokavannu bittu
Dharani seridhanu heege
Naranu aadhavanu dhivya
Karune thoridhanu
Mariyaambaaputhranu
Paripoorna mithranu!
- Ahha koodi

Parana haadidharu buvige
Karune saaridharu aaga
Kurubar kudidaru divyaguruva nodidaru
Thvareyindha bandharu
Vara bedikondaru!
- Ahha koodi

Bandhu panditharu koodi thandhu
Kaanikkeya aathanmundhe
Ettaru bhakthiyinda manidharu
Thandhe prithi thilidharu
Mundhe maargagondaru!
- Ahha koodi

Naraka thappisuva uragashirava
Chedisuva shaapa
Bharava nigisuva daivavarava paalisuva
Guruvannu harshadi
Nerediga bhagisuva!
- Ahha koodi

Namage bhodisuva bahala mamathe
Huttisuva sathya
Kramava thilisuva nithya shrameya
Nillisuva ramaniyanaathanu
Namagaatha shreshtanu!
- Ahha koodi

Jayava paalisuva mruthyubhayava
Harisuva thanna
Dhayava thorisu raktha krayavannithiruva
Nayavaagi nadesuvaashrayanannu
Nudisuva!
- Ahha koodi

songs.title: Andhu ondhu dhinadhalli
songs.text:
Andhu ondhu dhinadhalli
Aa ondhu belakinalli
Betheleheminalli
Yesu huttidhanu! (2)

Aa raathriyalli kurubaru
Holadhalli hindu kaayuvaaga
Thandha vaartheyaa! (2)

Haaduthaa dhootharu
Jagakella saaridharu
Yesuvina..aa..Janana vaartheya! (2)

Banniri ellaru
Godhaliya balige
Yesuvannu nodi santhosisuvaa! (2)

songs.title: Maayavadha lokavellavu
songs.text:
Maayavadha lokavellavu
Maayeyolagana maayavee
Kaayuvakhilopaayavu adhaayavellaa
Maayavee!

Huttidhaagalenu thandhevu
Bittu hoguva kaaladhi
Kattikondu hogalaarevu
Battabayale appudhu!

Thaayi thandhe bandhu mithraru
Nyaaya madadi makkalu
Praayavulla snehitharu
Maayavaagi poparu!

Dhaanyavo dhanalaabhavi
Chaithanyavo ghanakirthiyo
Maanyavenipa boomigalu
Shoonyavaagi popavu!

Lokabhogavu siriyu mahimeyu
Jokeyaadha kaayavu
Ekasamayadalliye
Bhaki illadhe popavu!

Kaasuveesadhi raasi maaya
Mosa baruvudhu nischaya
Yesuvanne aathmadaasthiyaasaraagi
Maadiko!

songs.title: Dhevara makkalige
songs.text:
Dhevara makkalige
Idhe jeevavu paradolage
Dhevara bhakthara dhivisi bhaagyava
Nivanu bhaavisirai!

Thandheya raajyadolu
Ive chandhadha vaasagalu
Kundhadha kshemava sundarasthaanava
Hondhalu seruvirai!

Alli kanniriradu avarallina edaralidu
Ellaru harushisi alli dhukhaadi
Galellava nigiparai!

Koodi paraathparanaa sthuthimaadi
Krupaanvithanaa
Beduva janarige nididha varagala
Paadutha saaruvevai!

songs.title: Prarthane bhakthige guruthu
songs.text:
Prarthane bhakthige guruthu
Olle guruthu - neenu
Prarthaneyindale baaluvi kalithu!

Prarthane bhakthana balavu
Dhodda balavu - nithya
Prarthane indhale
Dhevara balavu!

Shodhanakaaladhi shaanthi
Dhivya shaanthi - untu
Vedhane huttalu popudhu bhranthi!

Roga huttuvaaga bedu
Neenu bedu - aaga
Begane kashtavu popudhu nodu!

Vishvaasa hechhisa bedu
Nithya bedu - thandhe
Vishvaasa hechhisi dheevipa nodu!

Thandheye kodu ninna aathma
Praarthanaathma - eega
Bandhemma kaaryava saagisu aathma!

songs.title: Shuddha Yesuve ninna beedidhe - pari
songs.text:
Shuddha Yesuve ninna beedidhe - pari
Shuddhisu thadavilladhe!

Brasghtalokadhalli dushtarathalliyam
Eshtadindha seridhe - nija
Shistajanarigellaa eshtavadha
Sarvothkristhaagneyannu meeridhe!

Dhundhugaarathanadhindha jeevisi naa
Nandhakaaradi meredhe - innu
Mundhe sikkuva nithyaanandhavannu
Thalli, mandhamathiyanolidhe!

Paamaramanadalli kshemavendhu
Nambi, thaamasavanu maadidhe - bahu
Premadhi thumbidha swamiya noyisi
Bhomiyolage baalidhe!

Lokadallaarannu jokeyum pididharu
Shokavaariparillave - mahaa
Bhikaradim baruvekadhevograva
Sveekarisuvarillave!

Eega bandhenu
Dheva vegadhi ninnede
Aagisennaya praarthane - mano
Rogadhi bidisutha neegisu dhukhava
Koogidhe priya karthane!

songs.title: Shuddhanu Dhevaru dhyaanisiri - pari
songs.text:
Shuddhanu Dhevaru dhyaanisiri - pari
Shuddhanu Dhevaru dhyaanisiri
Shuddhanu shuddhanu
Shuddhanu annutha
Shuddharehovana paadidarai!

Paapavanendhigu hesuvanu - kadu
Paapiyanendhigu serisunu
Paapadha shiravanu bharadalli chedhisi
Tha pishaachana kodahuvanai!

Neethivantharanu kaayuvanu - athi
Preethiya bhaavadim noduvanu
Bheethiyannellava thappisi bakhttara
Aathanu mukthige seripanai!

Shuddhatheyannu paripaalisuthaa - pari
Shuddhatheyannu thaam puttisutha
Buddhiya nuthanamaadisi nammanu
Shuddhara maargadhol nadisuvanai!

songs.title: Hrudayavemba baagila baliyalli

lines: Puthrana vaakyava mananava maadiri - mithrane aaguvanu!

songs.text:
Hrudayavemba baagila baliyalli
Yesu swamiyu - ninthu
Sadayanaagi thattuthiruvanu
Sakalavidhavaagi!

Anyanantheya ninthiruvavanu
Avalokisu bega - aatha
Nanyanalla lokarakshaka
Athmana snehithanu!

Karunashaaliyaadha kaarana
Kaadhiruvanu nimage - aathana
Karuneyannu thilidhu neevu
Maanavagaiyiri!

Eshtaravarage nillisikondu
Peedisuthiruviri - aathanu
Eshtodhayadhim kareyuthaliruvanu
Nimmanu mithrare!

Mithranu nijavu mithranu nijavu
Mithranu paapige - vara
Puthrana vaakyava mananava maadiri - mithrane aaguvanu!

Karuneyindha thanna karagala
Needutthaa ninthihanu - nimmanu
Poroge serisi appikollalu - niruthavu kaadhihanu!

Baagilu theredhu serisi kolliri
Ninthiha parbhuvannu - nimmasa
Raagavagi shuddhiya maadi
Balava needuvanu!

Serisikolliri hrudayagalalli
Shri kristhesuvannu - aathana
Serisikondre koduvanu nimage
Sthira jeeva krupeyannu!

songs.title: Nee beku sarvadha uddhaaraka
songs.text:
Nee beku sarvadha uddhaaraka
Ennaaru kodoru sushanthiye

O Yesu neenagathya Yesu neenagathya
Kai chaachi nanagiga sahaaya tha!

Nee beku saravadhaa neeniddhare
Gandaanthradhalliyu paraaguve
- O Yesu

Nee beeku sarvadha nannondhige
Maayadha jagadhalli neeyemagaashraya
Kaayo vimochakane!

Paramadhayakarane - nee
Dharaniya bhaskarane
Nararige maargavu varagala moolavu
Karuneya saagarane!

Adhipathiyaadhavane - nee
Madhura krupaamruthane
Budharu suseveya vividhadhi maadalu
Adhika harushagolisai!

Arasanu ninemage - athi
Bharadhalli ninnedege
Smaraneya maadutha baruvevu karthane
Harasemmanaadarisai!

songs.title: Sundhara rakshakane - ninna
songs.text:
Sundhara rakshakane - ninna
Vandhitha naamavane
Kundhadhe keerthisi endhigu haadutha
Bandhu bajipevayya! (2)

Nararoolalaipathiye - nee
Parimala vaasaneye
Dharaniya bhakthara smaranege yogyanu
Niruthavu sadhguruve!

Saayadha naravarane - nee
Gaayava maanipane
Ella bhumiyalli dhoddadhaayithu
Ega shuddha neethi olle sukhavu
Sathyavaadha preethi nelegondavu!

Bethleheminalli Yesuswamiyu
Nararupadhalli huttidhagalu
Jeevadha prakasha praabhe kottithu
Maranadha paasha bechhi hoyithu!

songs.title: Ondhu oorinalli ondhu belaku
songs.text:
Ondhu oorinalli ondhu belaku
Andhakaaradalli thoralaayithu
Neethi sooryanu
Bethleheminalli Papakathalalli kanthi kottanu!
Neenilladhiddhare sothoguve
- O Yesu

Eegaa nararalli dhivyakrupeyu

Nee beku saravadha sunathane
Nee helidhantheye naa maduve
- O Yesu

Nee beku sarvadha pavithrane
Maadenna hrudhayam pavithrave
- O Yesu

songs.title: Paraathparana Rajyavu
songs.text:
Paraathparana Rajyavu
Mahaa visthaaravaadhaddhu
Navelli vaasisidharu
Kaapaaduvavanaathanu!

Sarva gnanaadha
Dhevare Alaisu namma prarthane
Ee maneyalli nammannu
Sanmargadhalli nadisu!

Svavaasa neenu kottaddhu
Adhikavadha dhayavu
Idhannu ninage hothu
Prathishte maadi kondevu!

Ee maneyalli endhigu
Sukshema dhayapaalisu
Illi nammondhige iddhu
Nammannu aashirvadhisu!

Bittoguvantha kaalavu
Saavaaguvalli baralu
Mellokadhalli nithyavu
Shreshtanivaasa nemisu!

songs.title: Ee varegemma
songs.text:
Ee varegemma
Dhevaru
Sahaya maadiddhaane
Ee varege yaavaagalu
Nammannu kaadhiddhane
Ee varegemma nadisi
Santhosha dayapaalisi
Uddhaara maadiddhane!

Samsthuthi ninagesuve
Samkirthi namaskaara
Nischala preethiyindhale
Swaprajeya vichara
Nee gaidhadhannu nenasi
Kondaadutheve harshadhi
Ninnellaa upakaara!

Neenendhigu swajanakke
Sahaya maaduthiru
Sarvathra prathigalige
Samipadhalli iru
Kristhesu shramamuladhim
Samastha kashtadholagem
Nammannu paarumaadu!

songs.title: Kaanaa ooralli ibbaru
songs.text:
Kaanaa ooralli ibbaru
Vivaahavaaguthiralu
Kristhesu alligodhanu
Thannaashirvaada kottanu!

Adhe prakaara nammannu
Ee hothu aashirvadisu
Eegaaguvantha madhuve
Mangalamaadu karthane!

Sabheya madhalingane
Alaisu namma praarthane
Elli prasannanaagiru
Ninna kataaksha thorisu!

Ondhe kattaagi ivaru
Sadbaktharaagi nadedhu
Parasparaanuraagadhi Santhoshadhindha baalali!

Prapancha yuddha maadalu
Ivara balapadisu
Jeevaanthyakaala baralu
Ninna balili serisu!

songs.title: Aadhiyalli Dhevaru
songs.text:
Aadhiyalli Dhevaru
Sthri purushara ibbara untu maadi
Avara thaane ondhu maadidha!

Dhaiva katle merege
Eega aadha madhuve
Srushtikarthanindhale Aashirvaadha hondhuthe!

Paraspara preethiya
Ibbarallu huttisu
Jeevadhanthya mattigu
Aikyadhalli irisu!

Ella kaaladhalliyu
Obbarannu obbaru
Modhadhindha sairisi
Jeevanva maadali!

Shatrugala baanakku
Paapakarma dhoshakku
Ivarannu thappisi
Preethiyindha kaapaadu!

Sukha dhukhadhalliyu
Ivarannudhdharisu Jeevadhanthya baralu
Ninna hathra serisu!

songs.title: Haudhu ramya nivaasavidhe
songs.text:
Haudhu ramya nivaasavidhe
Devajanarigoskaravu
Namma ParamaThandhe thaane
Alli sthalava koduvanu
Innu mele
Haudhaudhu Alli kooduvevendhigu!

Aa mahaa sukha dheshastarol
Thumbaanandavu aaguvadu
Mathu kanniru mukhagalol
Endhu kaanadhe iruvadhu
Innu mele haudhaudhu
Alli kooduvevendhigu!

Entha korike koodisuva
Paramothama karthanige
Nithya sthothrava arpisuva
Ellaa bhakthara sangadhale
Innu mele haudhaudhu
Alli kooduvevendigu!

songs.title: Haa enthaa amulya mithra
songs.text:
Haa enthaa amulya mithra
Namagiga sikkidha
Paapa dukha bhayavella
Parihaara maadidha
Sthiranandha samadhana
Hondhalaashisidhare Yesu swamiyannu nithya
Beduthiru manave!

Shodhane untaaguvaga
Thaapathrayadhalliyu
Manadhalli kuggabedaa
Japamaduthaa iru
Nanbathakka intha mithra
Bere yaaru illavu
Ninna dhukhavella balla
Aathukolluthaa iru!

Thumbaa vyasana upadhra
Thondhareyu bandharu
Yesunaatha nithyaashraya
Bedikollutha iru
Nindhe peede kalavala
Yaava kashta bandharu
Sarvashakthana aadhara
Endhu thappi hogadhu!

songs.title: Athishayavaravallave - karthanaadhesu
songs.text:
Athishayavaravallave - karthanaadhesu
Athishayavaravallave Mithiyilladha
Dheva Suthanu rakshakanaagi
Kshithiyavarellarige Gathiyuntumaadhiddhu!

Narakuladhavarellaro - paapadhindha
Narakapaathraraadaru Varamukthimaarga vanariyadeyaleyalu
Karuniyaadhesuvu poreya
Baliyaadhaddhu!

Thoruvakhila vasthuvu - aakaashadha
Thaare chandhranu sooryanu
Mooru lokadholiha saarasrushtigalellaa
Ee rakshakage saribaaravu idhu saathyaa!

Uthamabhaagyagala hondhuvadhakke
Ettha hodharo sikkavu
Etthu rakthakrayava nithya jeevakkagi
Utthaanavanu hondhi
Bhakthara poreddhaddhu!

songs.title: Jeevadhindha eddhavane - ninna
songs.text:
Jeevadhindha eddhavane - ninna
Araadhane maadvevu.
Jeevadha adhipathiye
Ninna araadhane maadvevu.

Hallelujah, hosanna (4)

Maranava geddhavane
Ninna araadhane maadvevu,
Paathala jaysidhavane
Ninna araadhane maadvevu!

songs.title: Mahime mahime, sadhaa aathanige
songs.text:
Mahime mahime, sadhaa aathanige
Yesu Raajanigendigagali
Rakshanaandhava needidha
Karthana endhendhu haadi kondaduve.

Aha anandhave, paramaanandhave
Swargadhaanandhave endhigu
Athi ghoravaadha paapadha bhandhadhi
Nannanendhigu bidisidhanu! (2)

songs.title: Yesu hesaralli Yesu hesaralli
songs.text:
Yesu hesaralli Yesu hesaralli
Jayavu nammadhu - hallelujah Yesu hesaralli,
Yesu hesaralli
Pishaachi odvanu
Yesu hesaretthuvaaga edhuraali beelvanu.
Yesu Yesu ella
Yesu jayavu nammadhu!
Hindhirugenu naa...

songs.title: Yesu kristhane aaraadhisuve
songs.text:
Yesu kristhane aaraadhisuve
Neene nannaya rakshakanu (2)
Ninna rakthadhindha nanba shuddhisidi
Ninna baasundegalindha - nan
Gunapadisidhi Yesu raajane hallelujah
Mruthyunjayane nin kondaaduve!

songs.title: Naa ninnanne preethisuve (3)
songs.text:
Naa ninnanne preethisuve (3)
Hinthirugenu naa...

Nin sannidhiyol seri naanu
Nin maargadholu nadeyuve
Kashta dukha bandharu
Hindhirugenu naa...
Nin sannidhiyol

Naa ninnanne aaraadhisuve (3)
Hindhirugenu naa...
Nin sannidhiyol
Naa ninnanne sevisuve (3)

Kurudanaagidhe karune thoridhi
Parama drushtiya needidhi
Karuna saagara
Paapiyaa Rakshisa
Tharegilidhu nee bandhavane! (2)

Jeeva maargadholu hoguve hoguve Yesu
Raajana hindhe hoguve
Bhaagya kaanaanige seruvaa varege
Sadha Aathana hindhe hoguve! (2)

songs.title: Yesu nanna Raja
songs.text:
Yesu nanna Raja
Yesu nanna odeya
Yesu nanna preethi
Yesu nanna neethi Yesuve sarvaswa!
Yogyanu nine,
Yogyanu sthuthige
Nithya nirantharavu
Srushtisidhe nanna
Stuthisalu ninna
Nithya nirantharavu!

songs.title: Nin sannidhiyol
songs.text: Nin sannidhiyol

songs.title: Kristhanalli maarpaatavilla (3)
songs.text:
Kristhanalli maarpaatavilla (3)
Kristhanalli maarpaatavillave
Illa nithya nithyakku.
Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah!
Ella kaaladolu ella veleyolu
Dhevare ninnanne sthuthipe
Rakshaka ninnanne sthuthipe sthuthipe
Ella veleyolu sthuthipe!

Aadhiyu neene, anthyavu neene
Jyothiyu neene,
Nanna bhaagyavu neene! (2)

Thandheyu neene, thaayiyu neene
Bandhuvu neene nannellavu neene! (2)

Maargavu neene, sathyavu neene
Jyothiyu neene, nan jeevavu neene! (2)

Sahayavu neene santhoshavu neene
Shanthiyu neene, vishraanthiyu neene! (2)

songs.title: Santosha ukkutthe (2)

lines: Santosha ukke ukkutthe - Hallelujah Yesu nanna rakshaka

songs.text:
Santosha ukkutthe (2)
Santosha ukke ukkutthe - Hallelujah Yesu nanna rakshaka
Nanna paapa tholedha,
Santhosha ukke ukkutthe!

Dhaari thappi naa nadedhe
Adhe dhaariyalli naa nadedhe
Aadharu Yesu kaibidadhe
Thaane bandhu rakshisidhaa
Inttha volle Yesu nanna
Swantha rakshakaa! (2)

Paapadhalli iruvavaru
Paadhaladhalli aleyuvaru
Naano paralogadholu
Hosa haadu haaduve
Kone varege kaayuvaa nanna
Volle Yesuvu! (2)

songs.title: Geetham geetham

lines: Innu dhoothaganagala dhwaniyannu keli bhayapattu nadugidharu!

songs.text:
Geetham geetham
Jaya jaya geetham
Kai thatti haaduvevu
Yesu Raaja sattheddhanu hallelujah
Jayavendhu bhajisuvevu!

Beda beda aluvudu beda
Odi hogi saariri
Yesu Raja sattheddhanu - hallelujah
Jayavendu bhajisuvevu!

Beda beda aluvudhu beda
Hogiri galilaayakke
Thaanu helidha haage thirugi eddhanu
Oduttha prakatisiri!

Anna kaayafarellara sanghavu
Naduguttha odidharu
Innu dhoothaganagala dhwaniyannu keli bhayapattu nadugidharu!

Dhwaragal theredu dhayiryadhi nadeyiri
Jayaveeranu baralu
Nimma mela thaala vaadhyagal
Thutthoorigalannetthi dhwanisiri!

songs.title: Hallelujah Dhevarige
songs.text:
Hallelujah Dhevarige
Halleluya Raajanige
Dhevaadi Dheva
Rajaadhi Raaja
Endhendhu nadisuvanu
Araadhane araadhane! (2)
Halleluya halleluya
Aaradhane nimage
Ahaha halleluya halleluya
Araadhane nimage!

songs.title: Jaya koduva
songs.text:
Jaya koduva
Dhevarige Koti koti stothra
Jeeva needuva Yesu raajanige
Jeevithavella sthothra (2)

Halleluya halleluya haaduve
Anandha dhvaniyindha hogaluve (2)

Nithiya hasthadhi sahisi nadesuva
Karthane nanna balavu
Hedharenu endhigu! (2)

Adbhuta karthane srushtige nayakane
Yuddhadi shoorane jeevisuva rakshakane!

Nambigasthanu, nannanu kaayuvanu
Parishuddha Aathmanindha
Abhishekha maadvanu (2)

songs.title: Bhinnahava keluvavane
songs.text:
Bhinnahava keluvavane
Nanna kannira kaanuvavane
Sukha koduvavane sthotra
Yesayya! (2)

Ninnindhale ella saadhya ayya
Maathondhe saaku ayya! (2)
Ninna mathondhe saaku ayya (2)

Mana marugi kara chaachi
Athishaya maaduvavane (2)
Ayya athishaya maaduvavane! (2)

Nan rogava shilubeyalli
Nee hotthu theerisidhe (2)
Ayya nee hotthu theerisidhe (2)

songs.title: Intha olle samayadholu
songs.text:
Intha olle samayadholu
Yesuve nin bali bandhevu
Ninna makkalaadha naavu
Ninnanne arasi bandhevu!

Namma mele dhayavidu swamy
Ninna karuneyannu thorisu (2)
Ninnanne rakshakanaagi kaanalu
Prerisu nannathmavanu! (2)

Dhevare naavellaru seri
Ninna paadhada bali koodi
Bandhiddheve karthane indhu
Thandhiddheve hrudhayagalindhu
- Namma

songs.title: Kondaatta kondaattave - nanna
songs.text:
Kondaatta kondaattave - nanna
Karthana sannidhanadhi
Anandha anandhave - nanna
Priyana paadhadalli!

Paapavella tholagithu
Shapavella neegithu
Yesuvina raktadhindha
Kristhanalli jeevana krupeya jeevana
Parishuddha Aatmanindha!

Dhevaadhi Dhevanu - dhina dhinavu
Thanguva devalayavu naave
Aathmana mudhre nanna mele untu
Athishaya athishayave!

Sarva shaktha Yesu
Jeevadhara Yesu
Endhendu jaya needuva
Ommanassinindha hosanna haadi
Oorigella saarona baa!

songs.title: Nanna priya Yesuve - neenu
songs.text:
Nanna priya Yesuve - neenu
Eshto sundhara -
Baala bangaara
Nanna baala bangaara!

Neeniruve nanage bhayave illa,
Neeniruve nanage solilla!

Hasiraadha hullina gaavalalli
Anudhinavu nanna nadesuve!

Dhari thappidaaga kara hididhu
Thoruttha baruve sudhariya!

Vairigalannu edhurisalu
Paralokadha bala needidhe!

songs.title: Kruthagnatha sthuthi haadu -

lines: Eriko koteyu mundhe bandharu Yesu ninna mundhe hoguva

songs.text:
Kruthagnatha sthuthi haadu -
Nannesuvige sthothradha geethe haadu
Karthanu, shakthanu, nambigasthanu
Maathinalli sathyavantanu! (2)

Eriko koteyu mundhe bandharu Yesu ninna mundhe hoguva
Hedharadhiru kadhaladhiru
Sthuthiyindha biddhu hogvadu! (2)

Shathruvina sene mutthikollalu
Shilubeya neraluntu
Haadona, stuthisona
Maargavu thereyuvudhu (2)

Sharira aathma praanadhalliye
Soluva samayadhalli
Sthuthiyodane praarthisalu
Aathmana bala sigvadhu! (2)

songs.title: Shri Yesu naama athishaya naama
songs.text:
Shri Yesu naama athishaya naama
Paapige impaadha naama (2)

Paapa pariharakkagi paapigala huduki
Dharanige bandha naama
Paapa rahitha jeevithadha
Maadhariya thorisidha (2)
Parishuddha punya naama -
Alleluiah

Ella naamadhalliyu melaadha naama
Yesuvina dhivya naama
Sarvajanarella adda biddhu
Stothra maadi (2)
Harshadhindha haaduva naama!

Lekkavilladhashtu paapa nanninda
Thegeyalu, nanagaagi bandha naama
Anyanendhu thalladhenna
Dhanyanagi maadalu bandha (2)
Unnathana punya naama!

songs.title: Nannesu Rajanu baruva
songs.text:
Nannesu Rajanu baruva
Asankhya dhootharodane (2)
Nannannu rakshisida - Yesu
Nanna raajanaagi baruva!

Baanalli belaku belagi
Banalli minchu minugi
Megagalodane ilidhu
Mega dhootharodane baruva! (2)

Karthan baruva dhinavu
Baktharige aa dhinavu thumbaanandavu
Yaaryaaru siddharagalillavo aa dhinavu
Thumbha dukhakaravu! (2)

songs.title: Ella ninna krupeyu - nanage
songs.text:
Ella ninna krupeyu - nanage
Ella ninna krupeyu! (2)

Paapadhindha bidisiddhu ninna krupeyu
Parishuddha golisiddu ninna krupeyu!

Rakshane hondhiddu ninna krupeyu
Sathya maargava arithadhu ninna krupeyu!

Aathmana varavu ninna krupeyu
Pavittrattmana falavu ninna krupeyu!

Yee varege badhukiddhu ninna krupeyu
Innu mundhe baaluvudhu ninna krupeyu!

Shanthiya neediddhu ninna krupeyu
Santosha golisiddhu ninna krupeyu!

songs.title: Nadipinchu naanavaa
songs.text:
Nadipinchu naanavaa,
Nadi saandhramuna
Dheva Nava jeevanaa maargamunaa,
Naa jenma thariyimpaa! (2)

Naa jeevitha theeramuna,
Naa yapajeya baaramuna
Naligina naa rudhayamunu,
Nadipinchumu lothunaku
Naa yaathra viraboya,
Naa deekshalu paliyimpa
Naa navala kaalidumo,
Naa sevaa jekonumo!

Rathranthayu sramapadina,
Raa ledhunu prabhu jeyamu
Rahaa dhaarulu vedhakkinanu,
Raadheyonu prathipalamu
Rakshinchu nee siluvaa,
Ramaniya lothulalo
Rathanaalanu vedhakittalo,
Raajillu naa padavaa!

Aathmaarpana Jeyakaye,
Aasinchithi nee chelimi
Aahamonu preminchu chune,
Arasithi prabuni kalimi
Aasa niraasaye, aavedhana nedhu raye,
Aathmaathika lemigani,
Alledu naavalalu!

Prabhu maargamu vidichithini, praathinchuta maanithini
Prabhu vaakyamu vadhalithini, paramaathmuni marechithini
Prapancha natanalalo,
Pravinya munu bondhi
Palahi nuda yuvadu,
Paatinthu nee maatta!

songs.title: Yesutho teevigaanu podhama
songs.text:
Yesutho teevigaanu podhama,
Adduga vachchuvairi gelvanu
Yudhdhanaa dhambutho bothama

Raa raju sainiya mandhu seranu
Aa raju dhivya seva seyyanu
Yesu raaju mundhuga
Dhwajamu batti naduvaga
Yesutho teevigaa vedalanu!

Visuvaasa kavachamunu dharinchuchu
Aa raju gnana manadhi nillpuchu
Anudhinabu saththini
Bodhinchu chunna vaarthamai
Yesutho teevigaanu vedalanu!

Sodhanalu manala chutti vachina
Saathaanu ambulenni thagilina
Bayamu ledhu manakika,
Prabhuvu chantha nundhumu
Yesutho teeviganu vedallanu!

Oh yuvathi yuvaku laraa serudi
Sri yesu raju vaartha chaatudi
Lokamanthaa yekamai yesu naadha golvanu
Saathanam bevaru neevu ninega!

songs.title: Parishudhdha, parishudhdha
songs.text:
Parishudhdha, parishudhdha
Parishudhdha Prabhuva
Varadhu thalainanu
Varnimpa galara

Parishudhdha janakuda
Paramaathma roopuda
Neerupama bala budhdhi neethi prabhava
Neerupama bala budhdhi (3)
Neethi prabhava

Parishudhdha thanayuda
Nara roopa dhaaruda
Narulanu rakshinchu karuna samudhra
Narulanu rakshinchu (3)
Karuna samudhra

Parishudhdha magunaa
Paramu lidu aathma
Paramaanantha prema bakthula kiduma
Paramaanantha prema (3) bakthula kiduma

Janaka kumaarathmalanu yeka dhevaa
Ghana mahima chellunu
Dhanara nithyamuga
Ghana mahima chellunu (3)
Dhanara nithyamuga!

songs.title: Endha Kaalathilum endha nerathilum

lines: Nandriyaal umami naan thudhippen Yesuve umami naan
Dhevanum neere, en jeevanum neere Raja rajanum en sarvamum neere!

songs.text:
Endha Kaalathilum endha nerathilum
Nandriyaal umami naan thudhippen Yesuve umami naan
Thudhippen thudhippen
Endha velailum thudhippen!

Aadhiyum neere, andhamum neere
Jothiyum neere, en sondhamum neere!

Thaai thandhai neere, thaadhiyum neere
Thaabaram neere, en thaaragam neere!

Vaanilum neere, poovilum neere
Aalhiyil neere, en aabathil neere!

Thunba nerathil en inbame avar
Innal velayil en maaridaa nesar!

Dhevanum neere, en jeevanum neere Raja rajanum en sarvamum neere!

songs.title: Enna en aanandham
songs.text:
Enna en aanandham,
Enna en aanandham
Sollak kudaathe
Mannan Kirishthu en paavathai
Ellam mannithuvittare!

Kooduvom, paaduvom
Aaduvom ondraai
Magilh kondaduvom
Naadiye nammai thediye vandha
Naathanai sthotharippom!

Paavangal saabangal kobangal
Ellam parikarithaare
Dhevathi Dhevan
En ullthil vandhu thetriye vittaare!

Atchayan patchamaai
Ratchippai engalukk arulinadhaale
Nichayam swamiayi pattriye
Saatchi pagara vendiyadhe!

Vennangi, ponmudi
Vaathiyam melveedu jeyakodiyudane
Mannulagil vandhu vinnulagil sendra
Mannanai sthotharippom!

songs.title: Endhan kanmalai aanavare

lines: Um kirubai thandheerayyaa Yesu Raajaa en belanaaneer
Ummai pugalndhu paadiduven Raajaa neer seidha nanmaigalai

songs.text:
Endhan kanmalai aanavare
Ennai kaakkum
Dheivam neere
Vallamai maatchimai niraindhavare
Magimaikku paaththirare

Aaraadhanai umakke (4)

Undhan sirakukalin nilhalil
Endrentum magila seitheer
Thooyavare en thunaiyaalare
Thudhikku paaththirare
- Araadhanai

Endhan belaveena nerangalil
Um kirubai thandheerayyaa Yesu Raajaa en belanaaneer
Edharkum bayamillaye
- Araadhanai

Endhan uyirulla naatkalellaam
Ummai pugalndhu paadiduven Raajaa neer seidha nanmaigalai
Enniye thudhithiduven
- Araadhanai

songs.title: Edho paadal kaatril

lines: Kaalai neram, neram - ho ho ho

songs.text:
Edho paadal kaatril
En nenjin baaram pogatha?
Enn kannil yekkam theeradha?
Athikaalai neram
thondrum geethangal orangal
Idhamaaga paayum kaadhin orangal
- Edho paadal

Aariraro paadal ketkum
Adhikalai neram - adhikaalai neram
Yengum kannai thoonga cheyyum
Idhamaana raagam, adhikaalai neram
Dhaaveedhin pillaikku
Thaalaattu paada
Dhaaveedhin sangeedhangal vendumo?
Meetpin seidhi konda
Thaalaattu paattu ketaa
Kaalai neram, neram - ho ho ho
-

Edho paadal

Thoodhargal ellam,
Vinn veliyil koottam kooda
Dheva kumaran pirappai
Vaalthi paada
Meippargalukku narchieidhi
Thoodhu solla Dhevan mettu thandhu
Paada katru thandharo
Nenjai eerpadhau raagama - en
Uyiril kalandhadhu seidhitya?
Oho ho…
Enai aalum vendhan,
Puvi vandha neram
Adhikaalai neram - kaalai neram
Thondrum geethangal
Idhamaaga paayum,
kaadhin orangal
Thoodhar paadal naanum ketka
Innoru kaalai thondraadha -
Athikaalai near
-

Edho paadal

songs.title: Alleluiah Kartharaye
songs.text:
Alleluiah Kartharaye
Yegamaai thudhiyungal
Avar nadathum seyalgal ellam
Paarthore thudhiyungal
Vallamaiyaai kiriyai seiyum
Vallorai thudhiyungal
Yelloraiyum yettu kollum
Yesuvai thudhiyungal

Rajadhi Rajanaam Yesu
Rajan Boomiyil aatchi seivaar
Alleluiah, Aalleluiah
Dhevanai thudhiyungal!

Thampurodum, veenaiyodum
Kartharai thudiyungal
Rathathinal paavangalai
Pokinar thudingal
Ekkaallamum, Kaithaalamum
Mulhangida thudhiyungal
Ekkaalamum maraadhavar
Yesuvai Thudhiyungal -
Rajadhi

Suriyanae, Sandhirane
Dhevanai thudhiyungal
Oli adhanai engal ullam
Allithorai thudhiyungal
Akkiniye kalmalhaiye
Padaithorai thudhiyungal
Akkiniyaai kalmanadhai
Udaipporai thudhiyungal -
Rajathi

Pillaigale vaalibarae
Dhevanai thudhiyungal
Vaalhvadhanai avar pannikae
Koduthu neer thudhiyungal
Periyavarae pirabukkale
Dhevanai thudhiyungal
Selvangalai Yesuvukkai
Selutthiye thudhiyungal

Aalhkadale, Samuthirame
Dhevanai thudhiyungal
Alai alaiyaai ooliyargal
Elhumbinaar thudhiyungal
Thoodhargale, munnodigale
Dhevanai thudhiyungal
Paralogathai parisuthargall
Nirappuvaar thudhiyungal.

songs.title: Sthothiram Yesu naadha
songs.text:
Sthothiram Yesu naadha
Umakkendrum sthothiram Yesu naadha
Sthothiram Seigindrom
Ninnadiyaar thiru
Naamathin aadharavil.

Vaanathoodhar Senaigal
Manogara Geethangalaal eppodhum
Oyvindri paadi thudhikka maaperum
Mannavane umakku.

Itthanaai magathvamulla
Padhavi ivvelhaigal engaluku
Ethanai maa thayavu ninkirubai
Ethanai Aachariyam!
4 Nin
Uthiramathinaal
Thirantha nin jeevapputhu valhiyaam
Ninnadiyaarku pidhaavin sannadhi
Seravume santhadham!

Indrai dhinamathilum
Orumithu kooda um naamathinaal
Thandha nin kirubaikaaga
Umakkendrum sthothiram sthothirame!

Neerallaal engalukku
Paralogil yaarundu jeevanaadha
Neere andri igathil veroru
Thettramillai parane!

songs.title: Oru thaai thettruvadhu pol
songs.text:
Oru thaai thettruvadhu pol
En nesar thettuvaar !

Alleluyaa (4)

Maarbodu anaippaare
Manakkavalai theerpaare! (2)

Karam pidithu nadathuvaar
Kanmalai mel niruthuvaar! (2)

Enakkaaga marithaare
En paavam sumandhaare! (2)

Orupothum kaividaar
Oru naalum vilagidaar! (2)

songs.title: Enni enni thuthi seivaai
songs.text:
Enni enni thuthi seivaai
Ennadangaadha krubaihatkaai
Endrum thaangum tham puyame
Inba Yesuvin naamame!

Unnai nokkum edhiriyin
Kannin munne padharaadhe ,
Kan manni pol kaakkum karangalil
Unnai moodi maraippare!

Yordhaan purandu varumpol
Ennnatta baarangalo
Eliyaavin Dhevan enge?
Undhan visuvaasa sodhanaiyil!

Unakkedhiraagave Aayudham vaaikaadhe
Unnai alaithavar unnmai Dhevan
Avar dhaasarku neethiyavar!

songs.title: Thooyaadhi Thooyavare

lines: Uyirulla varai nin pugalh paada vendum

songs.text:
Thooyaadhi Thooyavare
Umadhu
Pugalhai naan paaduven

Paaril enakku
Verenna Vendum
Uyirulla varai nin pugalh paada vendum

Seedarin kaalgalai kalhuvinavar
Senneeraal ennullam kalhuvidume!

Paarorin noigalai neekkinavar
Paavi en paava noai neekkidume!

Thuyarangal paarinil adaindhavare
Dhunbangal thaangida belan thaarume!

Paralogil idamundu endravare
Parivaaga enakkor idam thaarume!

songs.title: Santhosham pongudhe (2)
songs.text:
Santhosham pongudhe (2)
Santhosham ennil pongudhe -
Alleluya Yesu ennai ratchiththaar
Muttum ennai maattinaar
Santhosham pongi pongudhe!

Valhi thappi naan thirindhaen paavap
Paliyadhai sumanthalainthen
Avar anbuk kurale
Alhaithadhu ennaiye
Antha inba naalil endhan
Paavam neengitte! (2)

Saththuru sodhithida
Dheva Uththaravudan varuvaan
Aanaal Yesu kaividaar
Thaanaai vandhu ratchippaar
Indha nalla Yesu endhan
Sondhamaanaare! (2)

Paavathil jeevippavar
Paadhaalathil alhindhiduvaar
Naano paralogathil
Naalum paadal paadiduven (2)
Ennil vaalhum
Yesuvodu Endrum vaalhuven! (2)

songs.title: Magilhvom magilhvom
songs.text:
Magilhvom magilhvom
Dhinam agamagilhvom
Yesu raajan nam sondhamaayinaar
Indhap paardhalathin sondhakkaarar avar
Endhan ullaththil sondhamaanaar!

Aa aanandhame, paramaanandhame
Idhu maaperum paakkiyamae - intha

Chinnan chiru vayadhil
Ennaik kurithu vittaar
Thooram poyinum kanndukkondaar
Thamadhu jeevanai enakkum alhithu
Jeevan pettukkol enturaithaar! (2)

Endha soolhnilaiyum avar anbinintu
Ennaip pirikkaadhu kaathukkolvaar
Ennai nambi avar thandha poruppadhanai
Avar varum varai kaathuk kolven! (2)

Avar varum naalinil
Ennaik karam asaithu
Anbaai kooppittu serthukkolvaar
Avar samoogamadhil ange avarudane
Aadippaadiye agamagilhven! (2)

songs.title: Ennaalume thudhippaai
songs.text:
Ennaalume thudhippaai
Ennaathumaave, nee
Ennaalume thudhippaai!
Innaal varaiyilyum unnadhanaar seidha (2)
Ennillaa nanmaigal yaavum maravaadhu.

Paavangal ethanaiyo
Ninaiyaa dhirunthaar - un
Paavangal ethanaiyo!
Paalhaana noyai agatti gunamaakki (2)
Paarinil vaitha magaa
Dhayavai enni

Ethanaiyo kirubai
Unnuyirkku seythaare
Ethanaiyo kirubai!
Nithamunaimudi soottinadhu mandri (2)
Nithyamaana jeevanai eendhadaal

Nanmaiyaal un vaayai
Niraiththaare, poorthiyaai
Nanmaiyaalun vaayai!
Un vayadhu kalugaippol balangondu (2)
Oangum ilamaipol aagavee seidhadhaal!

Boomikkum vaanathukkum
Ulla thooram polave,
Boomikkum vaanathukkum;
Saami bayamullavar mel avar arul (2)
Saalavum thangume, sathiyame idhu!

Mannippu maatchimaiyaam
Maa Dhevanarulum mannippu maatchimaiyaam
Ennu vaayo kilakku merku thoorame? (2)
Mannil un paavam aganta thathoorame!

Thandhai than pillaigatku
Dhayavo dirangaano?
Thandhai than pillaikatku
Endha velaiyum avarodu thanginaal (2)
Sondham paaraatiyae thookki sumappaare!

Aariro aariro aariraaro
Aaraaro aaraaro aariraaro
Thoongu thoongu paala nee!

songs.title: Bethalayil Piranthavarai

lines: Anbu pera nintu paimpon malar thoovi!

songs.text:
Bethalayil Piranthavarai
Portri thudhi maname - innum

Saruvathayum padaithaanda
Saruva vallavar - ingu
Thaalmayulla thaai madiyil
Thalai saaikkalaanaar! (2)

Singaasanam veetirukkum
Dheva maindhanaar - ingu
Pangamutta pasum thottilil
Paduthirukkindaar! (2)

Munpu avar sonnapadi
Mudippatharkaaga - ingu
Moatcham vittu thaalchiyulla
Munnanaiyile! (2)

Aavigalin pottudhalaal
Aanandham kondor - ingu
Aatkaluda sathathukkul
Alhudhu piranthaar! (2)

Indhadaivaai anbu vaitha
Emperumaanai - naam
Ennamudan poi thudhikka
Yegiduvome! (2)

Kulirum paniyum kottinadhe
Komaganin kottinile

Annai marisudhanai
Pulmeedhu amilthuk kalhudhavanai (3)
Munnanai meedhutta
Chinnak kumaaranai (2)
Munnurai noolpadi innilathuttonai!

Kandhai podhindhavanai
Vaanorgalum vanthadi panibavanai (3)
Mandhaiyar kaanandha maatchi alithonai (2)
Vaana paran ennum njaana guruvaanai!

Semponnuruvaanai
Dhesihargal thedum guravaanai (3)
Ambara meviya umbar ganathodu (2)
Anbu pera nintu paimpon malar thoovi!

songs.title: Sthothiram seivene -
songs.text:
Sthothiram seivene -
Ratchaganai
Sthothiram seivene
Ratchaganai (2)

Paathiramaakka immaathram
Karunai vaittha
Parthibanai yoodha kothiranai - endrum

songs.title: Kurusinil thongiye kurudhiyum vadiya

lines: Dheva Sundhara mainthan uyir vidum kaatchiyaal

songs.text:
Kurusinil thongiye kurudhiyum vadiya
Kolgadhaa malaidhanile - nam
Guruvesu swaami kodun thuyar paavi
Kollaai kann konndu!

Sirasinil mulmudi uruthida araindhe
Siluvaiyil serthathaiyo - theeyar
Thirukkarang kaalgalil annigal adithaar
Senaith thiral soola!

Paathagar naduvil paaviyin nesan
Paathagan pol thonga - yoodha
Paadhakar parikaasangal panni
Paduthiya kodumaidhanai!

Santhira sooriya sakala vaan senaikal
Sakiyaamal naanuthaiyo -
Dheva Sundhara mainthan uyir vidum kaatchiyaal
Thudikkaa nenjundo!

Eettiyaal sevagan ettiye kuththa
Iraivan vilaavathile - avar
Theettiya theetchayil kurudhiyum jalamum
Thirandurund odudhu paar!

Erusalem Maadhe marugi nee alhudhu
Yengi pulambalaiyo? - nin
Erusalai athiban ila manavaalan
Eduththa kolamidho!

songs.title: Yesu Raajaa munne selgiraar
songs.text:
Yesu Raajaa munne selgiraar
Osanna geetham paaduvom vegam sentiduvom

Osannaa jeyamae (2)
Osannaa jeyam namakkae - endrum
Osannaa jeyam namakkae!

Neer mathram podhum enakku
Yegovah Rapha,
Sugam tharum
Dheivam Um thalhumbugalaal
Sugamaanom Yegovah
Shamma, en kooda iruppeer
En thevai yellam sandhippeer!

Neer Mathram
Podhum (3)
Enakku Neer
Mathram Podhum (3)
Enakku!

Yegovah Elohim,
Sirushtippin Dhevane
Um Vaarthaiyaal
Uruvakkineer
Yegovah Parisuthar,
Unnathar Neerae
Ummai pol veru
Dhevanillai Yegovah
Shalom, Um
Samadhanam Thandheer en ullathinil!

Yesuve Neere en aathma nesar
En mel evvalavanbu koorndheer
Ennaiye meetka thannaiye thandheer
Um anbirkku
Inai illaiye
En valhnaal mulhudhum
Umakkaga vaalhven
Neerae endrendrum podhum!

Alleluya thudhi magimai entum
Alleluya thudhi magimai
Yesu raajaa engal raajaa
Endrentum pottiduvom!

Thunbangal soolndhu vandhaalum
Thollai kashtangal thedi vandhaalum
Bayamum illai kalakkam illai
Karththar nammudane!

Yordhaanin vellam vandhaalum
Erigo kottai edhir nindralum
Bayamum illai kalakkam illai
Meetpar nammudane!

songs.title: Yehovaa Yeere
songs.text:
Yehovaa Yeere
Thandhaiyaam Dheivam

songs.title: Thandhaanai thudhipome - thiru
songs.text:
Thandhaanai thudhipome - thiru
Sabaiyaare kavi paadippaadi
Thandhaanai thudhipome
Vindhaiyaai namakkanandha nandhamaana
Villarkariyadhor nanmai miga miga! (2)

Oyyaarathu seeyone - neeyum
Meiyaaga kalikoorndhu nerndhu
Oyyaarathu seeyone
Aiyan Yesukunin kaiyai kooppi thudhi
Seiguvaiyae magilh kolluvaiye naamum! (2)

Kannaara kalithaayae - nanmai
Kaatchiyai kandu rusithu pusithu
Kannaara kalithaaye
Ennukkadangaadha ethanaiyo nanmai
Innumun mer sonaamaaripor peidhume! (2)

Suthaangathu narsabaiye - unai
Mutraai kollave alaindhu thirindhu
Suthaangathu narsabaiye
Satthu kulaindhunai sakthiyaakka thammin
Rathathai sindhi eduthe uyir varam (2)

Dhooram thirindha seeyone - unai
Thookki eduthu karathil yendhi
Dhooram thirindha seeyone
Aarangal pootti alangarithu ninnai
Atthan manavaatti yaakkinadhu ennai! (2)

Singaara kannimaarae - um
Alangaara kummi adithu padithu
Singaara kannimaare
Mangaadha um manavaalan
Yesudhanai Vaalhthi vaalhthi yetthi panindhidum! (2)

songs.title: Varuvaai tharunam idhuve alhaikkiraare
songs.text:
Varuvaai tharunam idhuve alhaikkiraare
Valla aanndavar
Yesuvandai!

Vaal naalai yellaam veenn naalaai
Varuthathode kalippathu yaen?
Vandhavar paadham saran adaindhaal
Vaalhvithu unnai serthuk kolvaar!

Kattina veedum nilam porulum
Kandidum uttaar uravinarum
Koodu vittu un aavi ponaal
Kooda unodu varuvathillai!

Alhagu maayai nilaithidaadhe
Adhai nambaadhe mayakkidume
Maranam ornaal sandhikkume
Maravaadhe un aanndavarai!

Vaanathin keele boomi mele
Vaanavar Yesu naamamallaal
Ratchip padaiya veru valiyillaiye
Ratchagar Yesu valhi avare!

Theeraadha paavam viyaathiyaiyum
Maaraadha undhan belaveenamum
Korak kurusil sumandhu theerththaar
Kaayangalal nee
Gunamadaiya!

Sathiya vaakkai nambiye vaa
Nithiya jeevan unakkalippaar
Un perai jeeva pusthagathil
Unnmaiyaai indru elhuthiduvaar!

songs.title: Nandriyal thuthi paadu -

lines: Erigo madhilum munne vandhaalum Yesu unthan munne selagiraar

songs.text:
Nandriyal thuthi paadu -
Nam Yesuvai
Naavaale endrum paadu
Nallavar vallavar podhumaanavar
Vaarthaiyil unnmaiyullavar! (2)

Erigo madhilum munne vandhaalum Yesu unthan munne selagiraar
Kalangidaadhe thigaithidaadhe
Thudhiyinaal idindhu vilhum!

Sengadal nammai soolhndhu konndaalum
Siluvaiyin nilalunndu
Paadiduvom thudhithiduvom
Paathaigal kidaithuvidum!

Sariram aathumaa aaviyinaalum
Sorndhu pogum velayil ellaam
Thudhi sathathaal ullam niraindhaal
Thooyarin belan kidaikkum!

Dhunmaargathir kedhuvaana
Veri kollaamal,
Dheiva bayathodu endrume
Aaviyinaal endrum niraindhe
Sangeetha Keerthanam paadu!

songs.title: Paavangal pokkave
songs.text:
Paavangal pokkave
Saabangal neekkave
Poologam vandhaaraiyyaa
Manithanai meetkave paralogam thirakkave
Siluvaiyai sumandhaaraiyyaa (2)
Kanneerai thudaithaaraiyyaa
Santhosham thandhaaraiyyaa (2)

Endhan Yesuve,
Endhan Yesuve
Endhan Yesuve,
Endhan Yesuve!

Thangathai ketkavillai,
Vairathai ketkavillai
Ullathai kettaaraiyyaa
Aasthiyai ketkavillai,
Andhasthai ketkavillai
Ullaththai kettaaraiyyaa
Naan thedi pogavillai - ennaith
Thedi vanthaaraiyyaa (2)
- Endhan Yesuve

Thaai unnai marandhaalum,
Thandhai unnai marandhaalum
Avar unnai marakkamaattar
Nannbar unnai marandhaalum
Uttaar unnai maranthaalum
Avar unnai marakkamaattar
Karam pidithu nadathiduvaar
Kanmalai mel niruthiduvaar (2)
- Endhan Yesuve

songs.title: Endhan jeba velai
songs.text:
Endhan jeba velai
Umai thaedi vandhen
Dhevaa badhil thaarume
Endhan Kottai, endhan thanjam neere
Ummai naan naadi vandhaen! (2)

Soraadhu jebithida
Jeba aavi varam thaarume
Thadai yaavum agatridume

prayersAndLiturgy.title: Prayers
content: Dear Lord, thank you for adding this new day in to our life. As Thou hast guarded us during the hours of sleep, so do Thou guide us during the hours of labor. May this day which Thou hast given unto us in mercy be of a good service unto Thee. May our burdens be not too heavy for us and may we not injure one another or displease Thee. If we fail in anything, let Thy wisdom correct us, thy mercy forgive us, and Thy love amend our fault. Give Thy peace in our hearts with Thee and with one another. Help and prosper us in the doing of our various duties; and defend us from inward evil and from outward harm leading to thankful rest. May we walk as children of God; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

O merciful God, be present with us and protect us through the silent hours of this night, so that we who are wearied by the work and the changes of this fleeting world may rest upon Thy peace. We thank Thee for being with us through our ways and we request your continued care. Pardon for all our mistakes. May you help those who watch or weep tonight; and give Thine angels charge over our rest. Heal thy sick ones, rest Thy weary ones, comfort Thy suffering ones, pity Thine afflicted ones and shield Thy joyous ones. We ask this in your loving name though Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: The Order Of Child Dedication
content: You have brought this child whom God has given you to be dedicated to God and to His service. By this act you affirm your sure faith in Christ Jesus and his Church, and you declare your desire for this child that he/she should receive all the benefits of consecration to God, and of the prayers of the church, and may soon grow and learn to know and follow the will of God; thus doing he/she may live a fruitful Christian life on earth and be led to the everlasting kingdom of God.

To accomplish this, it will be your duty as parents (and/or guardians) to teach this child the fear of the Lord; and to direct his/her mind to the Holy Scriptures and his/her feet to the sanctuary; to take responsibility to bring him/her up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord and to restrain him/her from all evil associates.
Question: Will you endeavor to do so, by the help of God?

Dear members, do you acknowledge your responsibility to provide all necessary support for this child to come to the saving knowledge of the Lord Jesus Christ and grow up in Him? Will you endeavour to keep this child under the ministry and guidance of the Church until he/she by the power of God shall accept for him/herself the gift of salvation, and be confirmed as a full and responsible member of Christ's holy Church? If so, will you say, “We will?”
[Child's full name] I dedicate you in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Prayer : O God, Our Heavenly Father, grant we beseech Thee that this child may grow in grace, knowledge and stature of our Lord Jesus Christ. By being Your faithful child, he/she may be renewed and strengthened by Your sanctifying grace, to serve You through all the days of his/her life. Almighty God, so guide and uphold these parents (and guardians) that their through loving care, wise advise, and holy example, this child may be led into faith in Christ and be strengthened in His righteousness, and everlasting joy and peace. Through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: Order For Baptism
content: Dearly beloved, who have come here desiring to receive holy Baptism, the congregation gives thanks to God for your coming, and prays that the Holy Spirit may dwell within you, and that your faith may not fail. In the hearing of this congregation you should now make known your purpose to accept the obligations of this holy Sacrament.
Do you truly repent of your sins and accept and confess Jesus Christ as your Saviour and Lord?
Do you believe in God, the Father almighty, maker of heaven and earth; and in Jesus Christ his only Son our Lord; and in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the giver of life.
Do you desire to be baptized in this faith?
Will you then obediently keep God's holy will and commandments and walk in the same all the days of your life?
O merciful God, grant that all sinful affections may die in this/these person(s), and that all things belonging to the Spirit may live and grow in them.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: A Prayer For Wedding
content: Dearly beloved, we are gathered here in the presence of God to give thanks for the gift of marriage, to witness the joining together of (MAN AND WOMAN), to surround them with our prayers and to ask God's blessings upon them, so that they may be strengthened for their life together and nurtured in their love for God.

Marriage which is an honourable estate is instituted by God, signifying unto us the mystical union which exists between Christ and His Church. Our Lord blessed it by His presence at Cana of Galilee. In marriage husband and wife belong to one another, and they begin a new life together in the community. It is a way of life that all should honour and it must not be undertaken carelessly, lightly, or selfishly but reverently and responsibly and after serious thought. This is the way of life, created and hallowed by God, which (MAN AND WOMAN) are now to begin. Therefore on this their wedding day we pray with them, that, strengthened and guided by God, they may fulfill His purpose for the whole of their earthly life together.

……………….(MAN AND WOMAN), I charge you both, as you stand in the presence of God; to remember that love and loyalty alone will avail as the foundation of a happy home. If the solemn vows which you are about to make be kept inviolate, and if steadfastly you endeavour to do the will of Your Heavenly Father, your life will be full of joy and the home which you are establishing will abide in peace. No other human ties are more tender, no other vows more sacred than those you now assume.

Leader : --------------(Man), will you have (woman) to be your wife, to live together in the holy estate of matrimony? Will thou love her, comfort her, honour and keep her, in sickness and in health; and forsaking all other cleave to her alone as long as you both shall live?
Answer : I do, with God's help

Leader : …………………..(Woman), will you have ………………(Man), to be your husband, to live together in the holy estate of matrimony? Will you love him, comfort him, honour and keep him, in sickness and in health; and forsaking all others, cleave to him alone as long as you both shall live?
Answer: I do, with God's help
Minister: Who gives this woman to be married to Man?
The father/parents/guardians come forward and takes the right hand of the women and give to the right hand of the man: I do
Joining right hand with right hand:

Man : I, ……………………, take you , to be my wedded wife, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish, till death us do part, and thereto I pledge thee my faith.

Woman : I, …………………., take you , to be my wedded husband, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish, till death us do part, and thereto I pledge thee my faith.
Leader declares : God has heard your vows, and we are witnesses!
What tokens do you give as symbols of your affection and integrity?

Receiving the tokens and prays : Let these Mangalsutra (chain) /and rings be symbols of a spiritual bond that links loyal hearts in a lifelong covenant. The wedding ring is the outward and visible sign of inward and spiritual grace, signifying to all the uniting of
……………….(MAN AND WOMAN), in holy matrimony, through the church of Jesus Christ our Lord.

Prayer : Bless these gifts O merciful Lord, which (MAN AND WOMAN) have set apart to be visible signs of inward and spiritual bond, which unites their hearts. Bless, O Lord, the giving of these symbols, that those who wear them may ever be faithful one to the other, and continue together in love so long as they both shall live; through Jesus Christ, our Lord. Amen.
(Here, as the congregation stands, the couple exchanges the tying of Mangalsutra and exchangeofrings Bible etc.)
After wearing the Mangalsutra and exchange of rings, holding the gifts on the other by their right hand, the man and then the woman says :
Man says : In token and pledge of the vow between us made, with this Mangalsutra (chain), I wed thee, in the Name of the Father, and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit!”
Women says :In token and pledge of the vow made between us, with this ring I wed thee, in the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit!
O Eternal God, Creator and Preserver of all mankind, Giver of all spiritual grace, the Author of everlasting life, send Thy blessings upon these Thy servants,

………………….(MAN AND WOMAN), whom we bless in Thy name; that they, living faithfully together, may surely perform and keep the vow and covenant made between them, and may ever remain in perfect love and peace together, and live according to Thy laws, through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen

Leader joins the right hands of the couple and says : Forasmuch as ………….. and……………., have consented together in holy wedlock, and have witnessed the same before God and this congregation, and thereto have pledged their faith each to the other, and have declared the same by joining hands, and by giving and receiving a ring, I pronounce that they are husband and wife together, in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Those whom God hath joined together, let not man put asunder. Amen.

Benediction : God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, bless, preserve, and keep you; the Lord graciously with His favour look upon you; and so fill you with all spiritual benediction and love that you may live together in this life that in the world to come you may have life everlasting. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: Prayer For Burial Of The Dead
content: I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will live, even though he dies; and whoever lives and believes in me will never die. (John 11:26,27)

I know that my Redeemer lives, and that in the end he will stand upon the earth. And after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God; I myself will see him with my own eyes, and not another. (Job 19:25-27)
For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it. I Timothy
The LORD gave and the LORD has taken away: may the name of the LORD be praised. (Job 1: 21)

Almighty God, the Lord of life, the conqueror of death, our help in every time of trouble, Thou O God are the one who does not willingly grieve or afflict the children of men; Comfort us we pray O God, who mourn; and we pray that you give us thy grace, in the presence of death, to worship Thee so that we may have sure hope of eternal life and trust in Thy goodness and mercy. Amen

O Lord and Master, who Thyself did weep beside the grave, and were touched with the feeling of our sorrows, fulfill now Thy promise that Thou will not leave Thy people comfortless, but will come to them. Reveal Thyself unto Thy sorrowing servants, and cause them to hear Thee say, I am the resurrection and the life. Help them, O Lord, to turn to Thee with true discernment, and to abide in Thee through living faith, that finding now the comfort of Thy presence, they may have also a sure confidence in Thee for all that is to come; until the day break, and the shadows flee away. Hear us for Thy great mercy's sake O Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

Minister says : For as much as the spirit of the departed has returned to God who gave it, we therefore commit 's body to its resting place, (minister shall take little soil and drop in to the pit thrice and say) earth to earth, ashes to ashes, dust to dust; looking for the general resurrection in the last day, and the life of the world to come through our Lord Jesus Christ, at whose coming in glorious majesty to judge the world, the earth and the sea shall give up their dead and the corruptible bodies of those who sleep in Him shall be changed and made like unto His own glorious body; according to the mighty working whereby He is able to subdue all things unto Himself.

I heard a voice form the heaven, saying unto me: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from henceforth. Yeah, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works go following them.

Closing Prayer : Almighty God, with whom do live the spirits of those who depart hence in the Lord, and with whom the souls of the faithful after death are in strength and gladness; We give Thee hearty thanks for the good examples of all those Thy servants who, having finished their course in faith, do now rest from their labour. And we beseech Thee that we, with all those who have finished their course in faith, may have our perfect consummation and bliss in Thy eternal and everlasting glory; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

Benediction : Now may the God of peace who brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, the great Shepherd of the sheep, by the blood of the eternal Covenant, equip you with everything good, that you may do His will, working in you that which is pleasing in His sight; through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: The Lord's Prayer
content: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. For Thine is the Kingdom, power and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: The Apostles' Creed
content: I believe in God the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth; And in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord; who was conceived by the Holy Spirit; born of the Virgin Mary; suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, dead and buried; the third day He rose from the dead; he ascended into heaven, and sitteth at the right hand of God the Father Almighty; from thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit; The holy catholic (i.e., Universal) Church, the communion of saints; the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body and the life everlasting. Amen.
prayersAndLiturgy.text: I believe in God the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth; And in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord; who was conceived by the Holy Spirit; born of the Virgin Mary; suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, dead and buried; the third day He rose from the dead; he ascended into heaven, and sitteth at the right hand of God the Father Almighty; from thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit; The holy catholic (i.e., Universal) Church, the communion of saints; the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body and the life everlasting. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: The Sacrament Of Holy Communion / Lord's Supper
content: Almighty God, unto whom all hearts are open, all desires known, and from whom no secrets are hid: Cleanse the thoughts of our hearts by the inspiration of thy Holy Spirit, that we may perfectly love Thee, and worthily magnify Thy holy name; through Christ our Lord. Amen

Ye that truly and earnestly repent of your sins, and are in love and charity with your neighbors, and intend to lead new life, following the commandments of God and walking form henceforth in His holy ways : Draw near with faith, and take this holy Sacrament to your comfort, and make your humble confession to Almighty God.

Almighty God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, maker of all things, judge of all men: We acknowledge and bewail our manifold sins and wickedness, which we from time to time most grievously have committed, by thought, word, and deed against Thy divine majesty. We do earnestly repent, and are heartily sorry for these our misdoings; the remembrance of them is grievous unto us. Have mercy upon us, have mercy upon us, most merciful Father. For Thy Son our Lord Jesus Christ's sake, forgive us all that is past; and grant that we may ever hereafter serve and please Thee in newness of life, to the honour and glory of Thy name, through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

Almighty God, our heavenly Father, who of Thy great mercy has promised forgiveness of sins to all them that with hearty repentance and true faith turn to Thee: Have mercy upon us; pardon and deliver us from all our sins; confirm and strengthen us in all goodness; and bring us to everlasting life; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
“Come unto me, all ye that labour and heavy laden, and I will give you rest.” (Matthew 11:28)
“If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just, and will forgive our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.” (I John 1:9)

“If anyone sins, we have an advocate with the Father; Jesus Christ the righteous; and he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.” (I John 1:1-2)
O Lord, holy Father, Almighty and Everlasting God, it is very meek, right and our bounden duty, that we should at all times and all places give thanks unto Thee.

Therefore with angels and archangels, and with all the company of heaven, we laud and magnify Thy glorious name, evermore praising Thee, and saying : Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of hosts, heaven and earth are full of Thy glory! Glory be to Thee, O Lord most high! Amen.

Almighty God, our heavenly Father, who of Thy tender mercy didst give Thine only Son Jesus Christ, to suffer death upon the Cross for our redemption; who made there, by the one offering of Himself, a full, perfect, and sufficient sacrifice for the sins of the whole world; and did institute, and in His holy Gospel command us to continue, a perpetual memory of His precious death until His coming again:

Hear us, O merciful Father, we most humbly beseech Thee, and grant that we, receiving these Thy creatures of bread and wine, according to Thy Son our Saviour Jesus Christ's holy institution, in remembrance of His passion, death, and resurrection, may be partakers of the divine nature through Him: who in the same night that He was betrayed, took bread, (here the minister may take the bread in his hands). And when He had given thanks, he broke it, and gave it to His disciples saying, Take, eat; this is my body which is given for you, do this in remembrance of me. Likewise after Supper, He took the cup, (here the minister may take the cup in his hands). And when He had given thanks, He gave it to them, saying: Drink ye all of this; for this is my blood of the New Covenant which is shed for you and for many, for the forgiveness of sins; do this, as oft as ye shall drink it, in remembrance of me. Amen.

We do not presume to come to this Thy table, O merciful Lord, trusting in our own righteousness, but in Thy manifold and great mercies. We are not worthy so much as to gather up the crumbs under Thy table. But Thou are the same Lord, whose property is always to have mercy. Grant us therefore, gracious Lord, so to partake of this Sacrament of Thy Son Jesus Christ, that we may walk in newness of life, may grow into His likeness, and may evermore dwell in Him, and He in us. Amen.

Bread : The body of our Lord Jesus Christ, which was given for Thee, preserve thy body and soul for everlasting life. Take this and eat in remembrance that Christ died for you and feed on Him by faith with thanksgiving in your heart!
Wine : The precious blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, the blood of the New Covenant shed for you on the cross of Calvary. Take this and drink in remembrance of Christ and be thankful to Him.

As you receive these elements of grace, remember you are part of our Loving Saviour's body for which He is the head. Go in peace with the assurance that God of all grace and peace rests upon you and bless the hands of your labour and cause you to live for his glory always. Amen.

May the Almighty God, who caused light to shine out of darkness, shine in your hearts, cleansing us from all our sins, and restoring you to the light of the knowledge of his glory in the face of Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
“Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.” Isaiah 49:16
Jesus said, "I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you.” John 14:18
For you did not receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption by whom we cry out, "Abba, Father." Romans 8:15
But my God shall supply all your needs according to his riches in glory through Christ Jesus.

The Lord said, “He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him and honor him. With long life I will satisfy him, And show him My salvation." Psalm 91:15-16

"I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever; and the bread that I shall give is My flesh, which I shall give for the life of the world." John 6:51

“The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ. For we, though many, are one bread and one body; for we all partake of that one bread.” (I Corinthians 10:16-17)

“Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God and knows God. He who does not love does not know God, for God is love. In this the love of God was manifested toward us, that God has sent His only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through Him.” (I John 4:7-9)

Christ our Paschal Lamb is offered up for us, once for all, when he bore our sins on his body upon the Cross; for he is the very Lamb of God that taketh away the sins of the world: Wherefore let us keep a joyful and holy feast with the Lord. (From I Corinthians 5:7-8; I Peter 2:24; John 1:29)

O Lord, our heavenly Father, we, Thy humble servants, desire Thy fatherly goodness mercifully to accept this our sacrifice of praise and thanksgiving; most humbly beseeching Thee to grant, that, by the merits and death of Thy Son Jesus Christ, and through faith in His blood, we and Thy whole Church may obtain forgiveness of our sins, and all other benefits of His passion. And here we offer and present unto Thee, O Lord, ourselves, our souls and bodies, to be a reasonable, holy, and lively sacrifice unto Thee; humbly beseeching Thee that all we who are partakers of this Holy Communion may be filled with Thy grace and heavenly benediction. And although we be unworthy, through our manifold sins, to offer unto Thee any sacrifice, yet we beseech Thee to accept this our bounden duty and service, not weighing our merits, but pardoning our offenses; Through Jesus Christ our Lord, by whom and with whom, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, all honour and glory be unto Thee, O Father Almighty, world without end. Amen.

The peace of God which passeth all understanding, keep your hearts and minds in the knowledge and love of God and of His Son Jesus Christ our Lord; and the blessing of God Almighty, the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, be among you and remain with you always. Amen.

prayersAndLiturgy.title: Great Sayings
content: Simon Peter answered and said, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God." (Matthew 16:16)

Jesus said to him," 'You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.' "This is the first and great commandment. "And the second is like it: 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' "On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets." (Matthew 22:35-40)

"Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age. (Matthew 28:19-20)

prayersAndLiturgy.title: How To Receive Jesus As A Personal Saviour?
content: Know that Jesus loves you and offers eternal life as free gift.
Know that you are a sinner by birth and by deeds, and the consequence is hell.
Know that Jesus died for your sins and took your punishment; Repent from sins and confess to Jesus. Ask him to wash you and cleanse your life.
Call Jesus in to your life and receive him as your Lord and Saviour.
prayersAndLiturgy.text:
Know that Jesus loves you and offers eternal life as free gift.

(John 3:16)

Know that you are a sinner by birth and by deeds, and the consequence is hell.

(Romans 3:23; Romans 6:23; I John 1:8)

Know that Jesus died for your sins and took your punishment; Repent from sins and confess to Jesus. Ask him to wash you and cleanse your life.

(I John 1:7-9; Heb. 9:14)

Call Jesus in to your life and receive him as your Lord and Saviour.

(Revelation 3:20; II Corinthians 6:2)

prayersAndLiturgy.title: Growing In Salvation
content: Have a strong faith in Jesus and be assured of your Salvation; begin to live a new life in Christ.
Enter in to a covenant relationship with Jesus through Baptism and receive the legal right of his child.
Be sanctified through Holy Spirit every day by meditating on his Holy Word and prayer. (John 15:3; Romans 15:16; I Timothy 4:5)
Be a witness to Jesus in the Church and society and show the fruits of repentance in your deeds and words. (Luke 3:8; Acts 1:8; Galatians 5:22-23; Philippians 4:5-8)
Be the disciple of Jesus by denying yourself, carrying your cross, obeying his will and growing Christ-like every day.
Live the values of God's Kingdom on earth;
participate and promote it by involving in social service and Christian mission.
Wait for Jesus' second coming and rejoice in your hope in Christ.

(Hebrews 13:5; Romans 6:6)

Enter in to a covenant relationship with Jesus through Baptism and receive the legal right of his child.

(Mark. 16:15; Colossians 2:12,23; I Peter 3:21; John 1:12; Romans 8:14)

Be sanctified through Holy Spirit every day by meditating on his Holy Word and prayer. (John 15:3; Romans 15:16; I Timothy 4:5)

Be a witness to Jesus in the Church and society and show the fruits of repentance in your deeds and words. (Luke 3:8; Acts 1:8; Galatians 5:22-23; Philippians 4:5-8)

Be the disciple of Jesus by denying yourself, carrying your cross, obeying his will and growing Christ-like every day.

(Mark 3:34; Matthew 11:29,30; Ephesians 4:11-30; Philippians 2:5)

participate and promote it by involving in social service and Christian mission.

(Matthew 5 & 25; Romans 12:12; I John 2:15-17)

Wait for Jesus' second coming and rejoice in your hope in Christ.

(Amos 4:12; Matthew 25:1-23; I Thessalonians 5:5-11)
